caption: The drawing is a technical diagram rendered in black ink on a light beige background, illustrating multiple views of a chair. The top left section shows a cross-section of the chair legs and stretchers, labeled "CROSS-SECTION OF LEGS AT A" and "TOP ELEVATION OF STRETCHER (Elevation taken at A below)" with curves and rectangular terminations at the corners. The top right section, labeled "TOP ELEVATION," displays a view from above, showing the outline of the chair's back and arms, the upholstered seat, and detailing the contours of the frame. Below, the bottom left portion of the image is labeled "SIDE ELEVATION" and depicts the side profile of the chair, featuring a high, gently curved back, an armrest ending in a spiral, and front and back legs that curve outward at the feet. The seat is rectangular with visible upholstery. The bottom right section, labeled "FRONT ELEVATION," shows the chair from the front, presenting two armrests with coiled ends, an upholstered seat, four legs with curving outlines, a stretcher connecting the lower front legs, and a shaped chair back. Measurements and notations are included throughout, with dimensions marked in fractions of inches. A legend at the bottom identifies the symbols for dowel pins, joints, and upholstery. The chair's design is symmetrical, and the line work is precise, intended for construction or reproduction. The title at the bottom reads, "ELEVATION VIEWS OF CHAIR-N.S.-161-3-10-FU Scale 1/8" = 1"."
title: Chair
